_meta.note: 一个任务一个文件。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

King's Recruit#002.src: Hey, {u}! You alright in there? Looks like we hit something.
King's Recruit#002.dst: 嘿，{u}！你在里面没事吧？看来我们撞到什么东西了。

King's Recruit#003.src: Exit the caravan and talk to the Caravan Driver at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#003.dst: 离开商队马车，与 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的商队车夫交谈。

King's Recruit#004.src: Hm... I swear I hit this same darn boulder every time I make this trip. Sorry folks.
King's Recruit#004.dst: 嗯……我发誓每次走这趟路都会撞上这块该死的大石头。抱歉了，各位。
King's Recruit#004.speaker: Caravan Driver

King's Recruit#005.src: Ah. Does this mean we have to walk all the way to {p} from here?
King's Recruit#005.dst: 啊。这是说我们得从这里一路走到 {p} 吗？
King's Recruit#005.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#006.src: Unfortunately so. Luckily, it's not that far from here. Just a straight path forward.
King's Recruit#006.dst: 很遗憾，是的。幸好离这里不算远。一直往前走就到了。
King's Recruit#006.speaker: Caravan Driver

King's Recruit#007.src: Well, nothing to do but keep moving! Tasim, {u}, I'll race you to the gate!
King's Recruit#007.dst: 好吧，只能继续前进了！Tasim、{u}，比比看谁先跑到大门！
King's Recruit#007.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#009.src: ... He's already gone. We'll have to catch up to him. {u}, lead the way.
King's Recruit#009.dst: ……他已经跑了。我们得追上他。{u}，你带路。
King's Recruit#009.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#010.src: Walk down the path towards the gate to the Wynn Province at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#010.dst: 沿着小路走向 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Wynn 行省大门。

King's Recruit#011.src: I don't suppose you know much about Wynn either, do you?
King's Recruit#011.dst: 我想你对 Wynn 也不太了解吧？
King's Recruit#011.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#012.src: Of course, the King of {p}'s been recruiting Fruma soldiers, but...
King's Recruit#012.dst: 当然，{p} 的国王一直在招募 Fruma 的士兵，可是……
King's Recruit#012.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#013.src: That war of theirs must be getting pretty bad if they need this much support.
King's Recruit#013.dst: 他们需要这么多支援，那场战争一定已经很糟了。
King's Recruit#013.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#014.src: Oh, there's Aledar! And the gate, by the looks of it.
King's Recruit#014.dst: 噢，Aledar 在那里！看样子，那就是大门了。
King's Recruit#014.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#015.src: There you two are! You'll have to be faster than that if you want to stand a chance against the undead.
King's Recruit#015.dst: 你们两个总算来了！要是想跟不死生物有一拼之力，你们得比这快才行。
King's Recruit#015.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#016.src: Yes, yes, we'll be faster next time. So, is this the gate marking the border between Wynn and Fruma?
King's Recruit#016.dst: 好好好，下次我们会快一点。那么，这就是 Wynn 与 Fruma 之间的边界大门？
King's Recruit#016.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#017.src: It looks like it, yep! Are you two ready for the start of our new lives?
King's Recruit#017.dst: 看起来是，没错！你们两个准备好开始我们的新生活了吗？
King's Recruit#017.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#018.src: {u}, why don't you do the honours? Go ahead and open that gate.
King's Recruit#018.dst: {u}，不如由你来吧？去把那扇大门打开。
King's Recruit#018.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#019.src: Enter the Province of Wynn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#020.src: Well, what are we waiting for? Let's go ahead and explore this province.
King's Recruit#020.dst: 好了，还等什么？我们去探索这个行省吧。
King's Recruit#020.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#021.src: Continue through the Wynn Province to the castle
King's Recruit#021.dst: 穿过 Wynn 行省，继续前往城堡

King's Recruit#022.src: So this is Wynn we've all been hearing about... It's beautiful.
King's Recruit#022.dst: 原来这就是我们一直听说的 Wynn……真美。
King's Recruit#022.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#023.src: I guess the war hasn't made it this far. This is what we'll be fighting to protect.
King's Recruit#023.dst: 看来战争还没打到这里。这就是我们要奋战守护的地方。
King's Recruit#023.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#024.src: Hey, recruits! Come over here, I have something to tell you.
King's Recruit#024.dst: 嘿，新兵们！过来这边，我有话要跟你们说。
King's Recruit#024.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#026.src: A soldier? What are you doing all the way out here?
King's Recruit#026.dst: 士兵？你怎么跑到这么远的地方来？
King's Recruit#026.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#027.src: There's a bit of trouble up ahead. They sent me out here to intercept new recruits.
King's Recruit#027.dst: 前面出了点麻烦。他们派我来这里拦下新兵。
King's Recruit#027.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#028.src: If you want to survive out here, you're going to need this.
King's Recruit#028.dst: 如果你想在外面活下来，你会需要这个。
King's Recruit#028.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#031.src: Hopefully we won't have to use these just yet.
King's Recruit#031.dst: 希望我们暂时还用不到这些。
King's Recruit#031.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#032.src: Good luck out there, recruits! Just follow this path, and there will be a bridge up ahead.
King's Recruit#032.dst: 祝你们好运，新兵们！沿着这条路走，前面会有一座桥。
King's Recruit#032.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#034.src: Ah, this must be the bridge the soldier was talking about. But it certainly looks very...
King's Recruit#034.dst: 啊，这一定就是那个士兵说的桥。不过它看起来实在很……
King's Recruit#034.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#035.src: Well, let's not keep the King of {p} waiting!
King's Recruit#035.dst: 好了，别让 {p} 的国王等太久！
King's Recruit#035.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#039.src: That's what I was trying to warn you about! Let's just get off this bridge before the rest of it collapses...
King's Recruit#039.dst: 我刚才就是想警告你这个！我们快离开这座桥吧，免得剩下的部分也塌了……
King's Recruit#039.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#040.src: Well, how are we meant to get to the other side of this ravine now? Ugh. Another thing gone wrong, just like-...
King's Recruit#040.dst: 那现在我们要怎么到这道峡谷的另一边？呃。又一件事出了差错，就像——……
King's Recruit#040.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#042.src: That's... weird. I was just thinking about something from before Wynn, but... it's gone. I can't remember.
King's Recruit#042.dst: 这……真奇怪。我刚才正在想来 Wynn 之前的一件事，可是……它不见了。我想不起来。
King's Recruit#042.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#043.src: Hm. I can't remember anything from Fruma either... {u}, how about you?
King's Recruit#043.dst: 嗯。我也想不起在 Fruma 的任何事……{u}，你呢？
King's Recruit#043.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#044.src: Nothing. It can't be a coincidence we all lost our memories at the same time, right?
King's Recruit#044.dst: 什么都想不起来。我们所有人同时失去记忆，不可能是巧合，对吧？
King's Recruit#044.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#045.src: No, but... We can worry about that later. For now, we need to find a way past this ravine. Aledar, {u}, you should look around for a way across. I'll keep looking here.
King's Recruit#045.dst: 不是，但是……这个晚点再担心。现在我们得想办法过这道峡谷。Aledar、{u}，你们去找过去的路。我继续在这里找。
King's Recruit#045.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#047.src: Search for another way across the ravine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#047.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 寻找另一条越过峡谷的路。

King's Recruit#048.src: Woah! That sure did the trick, {u}. Good thinking!
King's Recruit#048.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#049.src: Hey, Tasim! Come over here, {u} found a way over!
King's Recruit#049.dst: 嘿，Tasim！过来这边，{u} 找到过去的路了！
King's Recruit#049.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#051.src: Phew! We made it over safely this time at least.
King's Recruit#051.dst: 呼！至少这次我们平安过来了。
King's Recruit#051.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#052.src: If we just continue forward, we should make it to {p} in no time!
King's Recruit#052.dst: 只要一直往前走，我们很快就能到 {p}！
King's Recruit#052.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#053.src: Hmm? What's that guard doing here? We should probably talk to them if we want to pass through.
King's Recruit#053.dst: 嗯？那个守卫在这里做什么？想过去的话，我们大概得跟他谈谈。
King's Recruit#053.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#057.src: A group of corrupted have sieged this underpass. I can't let you enter without any armour.
King's Recruit#057.dst: 一群腐化者占领了这条地下通道。你们没有盔甲，我不能让你们进去。
King's Recruit#057.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#058.src: Then what do we do? We have to get to {p}!
King's Recruit#058.dst: 那我们该怎么办？我们得去 {p}！
King's Recruit#058.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#059.src: Do you see that cave over there? Caves such as those often contain useful loot that can help keep you alive.
King's Recruit#059.dst: 看到那边那个洞穴了吗？像那样的洞穴里常常有能帮你们活下去的战利品。
King's Recruit#059.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#060.src: If you enter the cave, you should be able to find some armour to protect you. After that return to me.
King's Recruit#060.dst: 进洞穴的话，你们应该能找到保护自己的盔甲。然后回来找我。
King's Recruit#060.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#061.src: What do you say {u}? Let's go see what's in that cave.
King's Recruit#061.dst: 你觉得呢，{u}？我们去看看洞穴里有什么。
King's Recruit#061.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#062.src: Enter the cave and find some armour at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#063.src: We should return to the guard to see if he'll let us through now!
King's Recruit#063.dst: 我们该回去找守卫，看看他现在肯不肯让我们过去！
King's Recruit#063.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#065.src: So you found some armor, huh?
King's Recruit#065.dst: 所以你们找到盔甲了，是吗？
King's Recruit#065.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#066.src: Yes, a helmet! Will you let us pass now?
King's Recruit#066.dst: 对，一顶头盔！现在可以让我们过去了吗？
King's Recruit#066.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#067.src: Hold on there, recruit. Before you can equip a piece of armor you first have to identify it.
King's Recruit#067.dst: 等一下，新兵。装备盔甲之前，你得先鉴定它。
King's Recruit#067.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#068.src: And how do we do that?
King's Recruit#068.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#069.src: You can identify items at Item Identifiers. They exist in every city across the whole world, and we keep one here for convenience.
King's Recruit#069.dst: 你可以到物品鉴定师那里鉴定物品。世界上每座城市都有，为了方便，我们这里也放了一位。
King's Recruit#069.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#070.src: Identify your helmet at the Item Identifier and then return to me with it equipped. After you've done that I'll let you pass.
King's Recruit#070.dst: 去物品鉴定师那里鉴定你的头盔，戴上之后再来找我。做完这些我就让你们过去。
King's Recruit#070.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#072.src: I see you have your helmet on. Fantastic, you may now pass. Let me open this door for you.
King's Recruit#072.dst: 我看到你戴上头盔了。太好了，你们可以过去了。我来帮你们开门。
King's Recruit#072.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#073.src: Good luck in there recruits! Even with your armour it won't be so easy!
King's Recruit#073.dst: 进去之后祝你们好运，新兵们！就算穿了盔甲也不会那么容易！
King's Recruit#073.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#076.src: Wow, that guard wasn't joking. This place is crawling with the corrupt.
King's Recruit#076.dst: 哇，那个守卫可不是在开玩笑。这地方到处都是腐化者。
King's Recruit#076.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#077.src: Well, we've got no choice but to make it through! Finally time for us to use these weapons we got. Let's go, {u}.
King's Recruit#077.dst: 好吧，我们别无选择，只能杀过去！终于轮到我们用上这些武器了。走吧，{u}。
King's Recruit#077.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#078.src: {u}, you take the skeleton in the front. We'll handle the two zombies in the back!
King's Recruit#078.dst: {u}，前面那具骷髅交给你。后面那两只僵尸我们来对付！
King's Recruit#078.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#081.src: This path opened up, let's continue through the underpass.
King's Recruit#081.dst: 这条路打开了，我们继续穿过地下通道吧。
King's Recruit#081.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#083.src: Over here! You're just what I needed!
King's Recruit#083.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#085.src: Finally, some backup! Wait a second... you're straight from Fruma aren't you?
King's Recruit#085.dst: 总算来援兵了！等一下……你们是刚从 Fruma 来的，对吧？
King's Recruit#085.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#086.src: Oh well, this area should be clear by now. {p} is just up ahead, after all.
King's Recruit#086.dst: 嗯，算了，这一带现在应该已经清干净了。毕竟 {p} 就在前面。
King's Recruit#086.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#088.src: Quick, you have to use an ability!
King's Recruit#088.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#090.src: Wait, it's running away! We have to save the Lieutenant!
King's Recruit#090.dst: 等等，它要逃了！我们得救中尉！
King's Recruit#090.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#092.src: Defeat the Goliath and free the Lieutenant.

King's Recruit#093.src: That sure was close... Thanks for the save, {u}!
King's Recruit#093.dst: 真是好险……谢谢你救了我，{u}！
King's Recruit#093.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#094.src: I think you three are going to make good soldiers - not many can handle themselves like you just did.
King's Recruit#094.dst: 我想你们三个会成为好士兵——没多少人能像你们刚才那样应付得来。
King's Recruit#094.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#095.src: It seems that beast dropped something, you should check it out before heading to {p}.
King's Recruit#095.dst: 那头野兽好像掉了什么东西，去 {p} 之前你们该去看看。
King's Recruit#095.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#096.src: Pick up the loot dropped by the Goliath.
King's Recruit#096.dst: 捡起巨人掉落的战利品。

King's Recruit#097.src: That item looks rare! Maybe there's an identifier around here.
King's Recruit#097.dst: 那件物品看起来很稀有！也许这附近有鉴定师。
King's Recruit#097.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#098.dst: 向 {p} 前进！我们快到了。
King's Recruit#098.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#100.src: We... we made it! We really made it! Sure was a close call at the end.
King's Recruit#100.dst: 我们……我们到了！我们真的到了！最后那一下可真是千钧一发。
King's Recruit#100.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#101.src: ... Still think those corrupted don't stand a chance against you?
King's Recruit#101.dst: ……还觉得那些腐化者在你面前毫无胜算吗？
King's Recruit#101.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#102.src: Ha ha. Very funny. Ah, {u}, there seems to be an identifier here for you to identify that rare helmet.
King's Recruit#102.dst: 哈哈。真好笑。啊，{u}，这里好像有位鉴定师，可以帮你鉴定那顶稀有头盔。
King's Recruit#102.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#103.src: And a blacksmith too, you can sell your old helmet there for some emeralds.
King's Recruit#103.dst: 还有铁匠，你可以把旧头盔卖给他换些绿宝石。
King's Recruit#103.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#104.src: Here it is, the end of our journey.
King's Recruit#104.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#105.src: The end of one adventure, but the beginning of another! Let's go inside and talk to the King!
King's Recruit#105.dst: 一段冒险的结束，也是另一段冒险的开始！我们进去跟国王谈谈吧！
King's Recruit#105.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#107.src: Welcome to the Province of Wynn! By your ragged appearance, I gather your journey here must have been quite the adventure.
King's Recruit#107.dst: 欢迎来到 Wynn 行省！看你们这一身狼狈，我想你们来这里的路上一定经历了不少冒险。
King's Recruit#107.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#108.src: This, recruits, is the noble fort of {p}, one of the great cities of our province!
King's Recruit#108.dst: 新兵们，这里就是崇高的 {p} 要塞，我们行省的伟大城市之一！
King's Recruit#108.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#109.src: As soldiers of Wynn, it is your duty to stem the tide of corrupted monsters ravaging this land.
King's Recruit#109.dst: 身为 Wynn 的士兵，你们的职责是阻挡蹂躏这片土地的腐化怪物浪潮。
King's Recruit#109.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#110.src: Although, you may want to gain some experience beforehand. Many lives are tragically lost every day...
King's Recruit#110.dst: 不过，你们最好先累积一些经验。每天都有许多人不幸丧命……
King's Recruit#110.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#111.src: Take this [{p} Teleportation Scroll] to aid you in your journey. Upon use, it will instantly bring you back to this city, wherever you may be.
King's Recruit#111.dst: 带上这个 [{p} Teleportation Scroll] 助你一路顺风。使用后，无论你身在何处都会立刻回到这座城市。
King's Recruit#111.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#112.src: With that, I must bid you farewell, more recruits may arrive at any time. Good luck out there, soldiers of Wynn!
King's Recruit#112.dst: 就这样，我得跟你们道别了，随时可能有更多新兵抵达。祝你们好运，Wynn 的士兵们！
King's Recruit#112.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#113.src: So! Wynn, huh? It's pretty exciting to finally be here.
King's Recruit#113.dst: 所以！这就是 Wynn，是吧？终于来到这里，真让人兴奋。
King's Recruit#113.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#114.src: I can't wait to discover what it looks like for myself!
King's Recruit#114.dst: 我等不及要亲眼看看它是什么样子了！
King's Recruit#114.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#115.src: Ha, well, I think I'm going to head in the direction of {p} soon, although there seems to be something called {p} on the way...
King's Recruit#115.dst: 哈，嗯，我想我很快就会往 {p} 的方向去，不过路上好像有个叫 {p} 的地方……
King's Recruit#115.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#116.src: Enough talking already! Let's get out there and help some people!
King's Recruit#116.dst: 别再聊了！我们出去帮助大家吧！
King's Recruit#116.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#117.src: And he's gone again... Well, I'm sure we'll be seeing him soon enough. For now, let's just see what Wynn really is like.
King's Recruit#117.dst: 他又跑了……嗯，我相信很快就会再见到他。现在，我们就去看看 Wynn 到底是什么样子吧。
King's Recruit#117.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#118.src: It's beautiful... Oh! I almost forgot to tell you, {u}.
King's Recruit#118.dst: 真美……噢！我差点忘了告诉你，{u}。
King's Recruit#118.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#119.src: There's this handy item we were all given on our way here, the Content Book. It displays most things you can do in this world; Quests, Caves, and much, much more.
King's Recruit#119.dst: 我们来这里的路上都拿到了一件很方便的物品，内容手册。它会显示你在这个世界里能做的大部分事情：任务、洞穴，还有很多很多。
King's Recruit#119.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#120.src: It also lets you track any content you want, which will create beacons for you to follow.
King's Recruit#120.dst: 它还能让你追踪任何你想要的内容，会产生信标让你跟着走。
King's Recruit#120.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#121.src: Here, why don't you try it out? Use your Content Book, and click on the highlighted quest.
King's Recruit#121.dst: 来，你何不试试看？打开你的内容手册，点击高亮的任务。
King's Recruit#121.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#122.src: There you go! I'm going to head towards {p}, at the end of the {p}.
King's Recruit#122.dst: 就是这样！我要往 {p} 去，就在 {p} 的尽头。
King's Recruit#122.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#123.src: You should meet me there once you've gotten a little stronger. Well, see you around, {u}.
King's Recruit#123.dst: 等你变强一点就来那里找我。好了，回头见，{u}。
King's Recruit#123.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#124.src: What are you waiting for recruits? Go identify your helmet at the  Item Identifier and then equip it in your helmet slot!
King's Recruit#124.dst: 新兵们还在等什么？快去物品鉴定师那里鉴定你的头盔，然后把它装备到头盔槽位上！

King's Recruit#125.src: Unless you'd rather stand around here all day, that's fine by me too.
King's Recruit#125.dst: 除非你想在这里站一整天，那我也无所谓。

King's Recruit#126.src: Well, what are we waiting for?

King's Recruit#127.src: Good luck in there, recruits! You're gonna need it...
